name: vec_write_all_unchecked
declaration: unsafe fn vec_write_all_unchecked < A > (pos : usize , vec : & mut Vec < u8 , A > , buf : & [u8]) -> usize where A : Allocator ,
documentation:
Writes the slice to the vec without allocating.

 # Safety

 `vec` must have `buf.len()` spare capacity.
rules: The caller must ensure that `vec` has at least `buf.len()` bytes of spare capacity.
